title: Owner verdict on D2: no amendment 3, ship meadow-snapshot-pacing at aa8852d1
context: Device verification at aa8852d1 found D2: on the macOS VM's fast GPU mode the change shows the Meadow's first scene 79 to 125 ms after the unchanged build against criterion 10.14's 50 ms. Interphase amendment 3 was drafted (carried batches held back only past eight frame intervals of estimated GPU time, shareLeft sizing), but its first spec review returned eight issues, including that the fast-mode cause is unproven and that the VM's GPU mode switches by itself, and slow-mode probes showed the rule gives no gain on cold opens. The owner then tested the aa8852d1 build on their own Mac and said: "The current version without Amendment 3 works perfectly. There is NO need for additional changes." The draft is archived at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/abandoned-amend-3/, and the spec, record and decisions file are restored to the amendment 2 hand-off with the owner's verdict appended to the decisions file.
options: Ship aa8852d1 with D2 recorded as accepted by the owner, no amendment 3
Continue amendment 3: answer its eight review issues, build, review round 4 and re-measure every device
option_reasons: The owner judged the build on real hardware and decided no further change is needed; round 3 is green, the Note10+ floor check passed, and D2 is a VM-only first-scene clause whose cause is unproven
The owner explicitly ruled it out, its first review found its cause unproven, and probes showed no gain on cold opens
outcome: Ship aa8852d1 with D2 accepted by the owner. Next: pipeline.mjs comment and promote, SHIP=1 run.zsh --resume, open the draft PR with mitosis's title and body, assign it and post the review notes. Windows 10.12 and emulator 10.13 not re-measured on aa8852d1 go to the final report as risks.
